description: This Kotlin source file defines the AlbumArtFetcher class, which implements the coil.fetch.Fetcher interface to load album art images in an Android application. It handles retrieving a bitmap, resizing it according to options, and returning a FetchResult for use in image loading within the app.

classes.name: AlbumArtFetcher
classes.description: A class responsible for fetching and processing album art images from a URI, resizing and decoding them for display within an Android app.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches the album art image, processes it according to specified options, and returns a DrawableResult containing the final bitmap.

methods.name: normalizeBitmap
methods.description: Resizes and re-renders the bitmap to match the desired size and configuration.

methods.name: isConfigValid
methods.description: Checks if the current bitmap configuration is compatible with the requested options.

methods.name: isSizeValid
methods.description: Determines if the bitmap size matches the required size constraints based on options.
